Throughout this dataset, “N/A” indicates a field does not apply to a given plant (e.g., a mothballed date for a plant that has never been mothballed), and “not found” indicates the field applies but the value could not be determined from publicly available sources.
1. Expanded dataset scope to include all operating statuses: announced, construction, operating, operating pre-retirement, mothballed, mothballed pre-retirement, retired, and cancelled.
2. Added data fields to track existing and developing plant-level capacity for all 8 primary chemicals.
3. Added data fields to track plant age and key dates: announced date, construction date, start date, pre-retirement announcement date, mothballed date, and retired date.
4. Added "Plant type" data field to indicate the feedstock integration status of the plant: chemicals only, refinery only, or integrated refinery and chemicals.
5. Added "Main production equipment" data field to denote the on-site equipment used to produce the 8 primary chemicals.

6. Added data fields to track the status of decarbonization technologies at the plant: carbon capture and storage/utilization, electrified process heat, low-carbon hydrogen, and bio- or waste-based feedstocks.
7. Added full parent ownership data in addition to immediate owner/operator data (where possible).
8. Removed "Feedstock accuracy" data field; all feedstocks are either confirmed or designated as "not found."

The most recent comprehensive annual review and update of this data was released in March 2026, with limited quarterly updates released in June, September, and December 2026. Changes to the dataset since the last annual review and limits of each quarterly review are described below.
1. Changes to field names: adjusted standard column header format so that only the first word is capitalized.
